in_sanskrit.name: देव्यर्थ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: देव (Deva) - god + यर्थ (Yartha) - purpose = देव्यर्थ (Devyarth) - God's purpose

in_hindi.name: देव्यर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (Deva) - god + अर्थ (Artha) - purpose = देव्यर्थ (Devyarth) - God's purpose

in_tamil.name: தேவ்யர்த்
in_tamil.long_meaning: தேவம் (Thevam) - god + அர்த்தம் (Artham) - purpose = தேவ்யர்த் (Thevyarth) - God's purpose

in_telugu.name: దేవ్యర్థ
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేవు (Devu) - god + ఆర్ఠ (Artha) - purpose = దేవ్యర్థ (Devyarth) - God's purpose

in_marathi.name: Devyarth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devyarth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Devyarth is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ meaning God and ‘Yarth’ meaning gift. This name signifies the divine gift of a child from the Gods.
